name: Abracadabra
fix_description: In _additionalCookAction (Action 0), do not reset the entire CookStatus struct. The current implementation returns CookStatus(false) which clears needsSolvencyCheck that was set by a prior borrow action (Action 5). Fix: preserve the needsSolvencyCheck flag across action boundaries, e.g., pass and return the existing status instead of creating a new one.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a few coordinated steps: flash-loan WBNB, buy the taxed token, exploit the LP balance/reserve mismatch via repeated skim() calls, then manually extract value through the pair and repay. It relies on understanding a protocol-specific token tax/business-logic flaw and AMM reserve accounting, but the execution path is still fairly direct and the PoC is relatively short.
